guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul (Joe Perry has a Bone Yard signature) / Brad Whitford Gibson Les Paul
models: Gibson Les Paul (Joe Perry has a Bone Yard signature)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Joe Perry is famously a Gibson Les Paul player (Billie Perry / Boneyard signatures), Brad Whitford also plays Les Pauls.
guitar.notes: Original was reasonable; refined to emphasize Les Paul as primary for both, dropped Strat mention as less central.

tone.target: dry Marshall crunch with gritty bite
tone.profile: dry Marshall crunch with gritty bite
tone.summary: A classic Marshall Plexi-style chain using OD 9 for initial bite, followed by the UK 45 amp model, paired with a UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve dry, aggressive hard rock tones.

rig.name: Aerosmith - Back In The Saddle - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise.
Provide initial grit and upper-mid bite before the main amp stage.
Add slight fuzz grit and aggressive bite without sounding overly scooped.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is used to add the required 'slight fuzz grit' that OD 9 might miss, keeping the tone aggressive but controlled.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall Plexi sound for hard rock foundation.
Provide the classic Marshall cabinet voicing.
Enhance upper-mid bite and tighten the rhythm tone.
Optional subtle thickening for rhythm parts (kept off by default).
blocks.gap: No specific modulation was requested, but Chorus is included as a versatile option.

blocks.purpose: Add depth and space for solos without washing out the rhythm.
Provide a natural room ambience to ground the aggressive tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the desired dry, aggressive hard rock tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance bite and aggression for a more authentic Plexi sound.
